testRunEvidenceAudit.scope: Checks exact TestRun UUIDs against stage-scoped structured evidence exports and their SHA-256 manifests; PASS stages additionally require completed runs, all-PASS assertions, and a UUID-bound dated user sign-off. Legacy IDs without exported bundles remain unresolved rather than being inferred as valid.

evidenceAudit.scope: Checks linked local evidence-file existence and active SHA-256 manifests; manifests explicitly labeled as historical execution snapshots are retained but not compared with the current worktree. This does not prove evidence completeness, business correctness, deployment, observation, or human acceptance.
